intent: Permit a sub-minute report timestamp delta only when independent evidence proves it is serialization or same-quote timing noise rather than a changed trade-lifecycle event path.

deal_sequence.time_delta_sign_constraint: none, but each delta must be reported

event_path_invariance: No source or include change may alter entry, order, stop/target modification, discretionary exit, Friday close, kill-switch close, or broker-request timing logic.
Trade-operation logs must show the same order/modify/close requests on the same ticks; a shifted modification or order request is disqualifying.
Every shifted exit must bind to the same frozen tick/quote and the same already-active SL/TP before that tick.

automatic_refusal_conditions: any missing EX5, MQ5, include-closure, setfile, tester, or tick-data binding
fewer than two deterministic runs per binary
fallback: NOT_EQUIVALENT; the rebuilt identity runs its own append-only Q03-Q10 chain.

failed_conditions: selected ablation-02 predecessor EX5 binding is missing
the rebuilt source changes break-even stop-modification timing logic
the rebuilt log shows the stop modification itself moved to 13:03:45
only one governed run per binary is bound by the current proof
